prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at his side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful K-pop idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright double-lidded eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth fair skin with a warm undertone, composed and elegant, bright golden-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum earrings. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.
Physique: A very tall, slim, long-limbed man with a runway build. Straight shoulders, a flat lean chest, a flat defined stomach, slender strong arms and very long legs, lightly muscled and elegant, with visible collarbones and a narrow waist. His head stays in correct proportion to his long frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice linework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.
Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the muscle and flesh fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: the painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every muscle and fold.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
